newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Aramco seeks to raise its refining capacity to four million barrels per day.
- Egypt offers 39 projects at a cost of $3 billion to Dutch and Italian investors.
- Infrastructure projects in Gulf Arab states to cost $200 billion including linking their power grid.
- Gulf Arab furniture imports to rise to $2.5 billion in 1997.
- Morocco expects to import oil worth $1.25 billion this year, up $250 million from 1995.
- U.S. investments in Tunisia rise to $100 million.
